templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, where the parties set the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law and jurisdiction, and sign.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard terms of the Common Paper Mutual NDA, letting both parties share confidential information for a stated purpose with mutual protection obligations.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a SaaS provider supplying a cloud service to a customer, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability limits, indemnification, and term.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level terms supplementing a Cloud Service Agreement, defining target uptime, response times, and service credits when commitments are missed.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to an existing agreement governing a provider's AI services, including use of customer input and output and restrictions on training models with customer data.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data protection terms under which a provider processes customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including GDPR/UK transfer mechanisms, security, and subprocessors.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate terms governing how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a provider performing professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, confidentiality, and liability.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing installable (on-premise) software to a customer, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, warranties, indemnification, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term agreement letting a customer evaluate a provider's product during a limited pilot period before committing to a full purchase.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving a partner early access to a product in development in exchange for feedback and participation in shaping the product.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a business partnership in which each party performs agreed obligations, covering payments, trademark use, confidentiality, and liability.
